charter: v2

# ADR-035 — Scarification and tribal marks on learner avatars (P11-033)

Status: **Accepted** (Tope, 2026-10-27). Implements ELEVATION §4.2 L903 and `cultural_design_bible.md` §6. Normative detail also lives in `assets/rive/lingafriq/CHARACTER_BIBLE.md` §8.

## Context

Some communities use **facial or body marks** (scarification, initiation marks, identity marks) with deep cultural meaning. Casual or decorative use in a game avatar system risks stereotyping, misattribution, or harm—especially on **hosts, guides, or child-facing characters**.

LingAfriq already ships **Vitiligo** and **hearing-aid** overlays with consultant gates (P11-034). Marks need an explicit product policy before any `Accessory/Marks_*` artboards are authored.

| Option | Description | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **A — Exclude entirely** | No mark cosmetics in the product | Rejected: silences representation for adults who want opt-in identity |
| **B — Opt-in learner overlay, gated** | Adults choose marks; strict review; never on cast defaults | **Accepted** |
| **C — Free cosmetic in loot** | Random or reward drops | Rejected: violates dignity and consent |

EXT-14 (cultural consultant) is **not** a blocker for writing policy; **shipping each pattern** remains blocked until EXT-14 sign-off is recorded (same as P11-034 review workflow).

## Decision

1. **Scope:** Marks apply only to the **learner avatar**, never to Polie, village hosts, guides, or Historical Personas by default.
2. **Age:** **18+ only.** Child accounts (`child_mode`, under country threshold) and teen accounts **cannot** enable or display mark overlays. The toggle is hidden, not merely disabled in UI copy.
3. **v1:** **No mark artboards ship in v1.** Policy and manifest fields land now; first patterns ship only after post-v1 review backlog clears.
4. **Opt-in:** User explicitly selects a pattern in customisation. **No** random assignment, loot boxes, streak rewards, or “surprise” unlocks. User can remove a mark with **one tap** at any time.
5. **Review before publish:** Each `Accessory/Marks_<Community>_<Pattern>` requires:
   - Two reviewers from the attributed community (EXT-13 pool when live; interim: documented native reviewers per `cultural_design_bible.md` §7).
   - EXT-14 cultural consultant sign-off (`consultant_id`, `YYYY-MM-DD` in item manifest).
   - Until both complete: max status **`expert_reviewed`**; never **`native_verified`** on avatar cosmetics.
6. **Representation rules:** Never used for villains, comic relief, or “exotic” framing. Patterns must match documented community attribution; no generic “tribal” filler textures.
7. **Technical delivery:** Alpha overlay artboard (same technique as Vitiligo) so every skin tone in the 12-tone system (P11-034) remains valid.
8. **Feature gating:** Accounts that do not qualify see no mark UI; qualifying adults see the category only when at least one approved pattern exists in the signed pack—**no empty category tease**.

## Consequences

- Studio and Rive authoring **must not** add mark layers to cast presets until a pattern passes §5 review.
- P11-045 (nested customisation) and economy cards **must** treat marks as non-monetised (ADR-032: kids never pay to look better extends to all identity overlays).
- OW items for mark patterns stay open until EXT-14 engagement is live; policy acceptance does not imply content exists.

## Alternatives considered

- **Strategy A (exclude)** — Rejected; adult opt-in with review is the charter-aligned middle path (ELEVATION “opt-in, reviewed”).
- **Strategy C (loot)** — Rejected; fails AC1 dignity and one-tap removal intent.
